test_requires_subclass_dispatch: test the requires_subclass_dispatch function to check if tensor subclass unwrapping is needed at runtime
create_subclass_meta: create subclass metadata from a list of arguments containing tensor subclasses for later reconstruction
unwrap_tensor_subclasses: unwrap tensor subclasses from a pytree of arguments into a flat list of dense tensors for tracing
wrap_tensor_subclasses: wrap a flat list of dense tensors back into tensor subclasses using pre-collected subclass metadata
wrap_tensor_subclasses_maybe_joint: wrap dense tensors into tensor subclasses handling both inference and joint autograd graph structures
